title: Does anyone have recommendations of any Claude Skills or tools to help select viable Options for smaller investments?
author: Exact_Suit3114
selftext: Hello! I am working on a bot that specializes in finding and trading options for investments between $100-$200. I have previously had some success with more expensive options but I want this project to focus on small options and not necessarily 0DTE. Capital acceleration is the name of the game here. Any recommendations for tools, techniques or otherwise? I haven’t found too many strong sources in my research thus far. Thanks!

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
At $100-200 a contract the spread is the whole game. A $1.50 option quoted 1.40/1.60 is about 13% wide, so filter on (ask - bid) / mid under 5% and real open interest before anything else, or the bot pays its edge away on every entry and exit.

Cheap usually means far out of the money or a few days from expiry. Near the money on a cheaper underlying with 30-45 days left decays slower and actually moves with the stock. And backtest on the quotes you'd really hit, buying at the offer and selling into the bid, never the mid, because mid fills flatter small contracts the most.

If you want that check on paper first, I built Quantradin this summer for it: every option trade pays the real quoted spread, free. quantradin.com. what are you pulling the chains from?
